from.place: Proof, ordinary scalar direct-image comparison: native-carrier form of the existing evaluation normalization

title: Native section normalization for semilinear direct-image evaluation
statement: For a varying sequence R of commutative coefficient rings and transition maps φ, a scheme map f:X -> Y, a level n, an actual semilinear system M on X, an opposite pro-etale object H of Y, and a section x in the native carrier of eval n (push f M) at H, the specified moduleEvalP comparison takes x to a section heterogeneously equal to x. This uses the actual chosen section-normalized evaluation comparison of def-sp-varying-ring-operations, without introducing any new functor or choosing any arbitrary witness.

source.place: Construction 4.1, coefficient-system evaluation and ordinary direct image; native-carrier form of the normalized comparison in def-sp-varying-ring-operations

proof.text: Unfold moduleEvalP to the unique comparison chosen by moduleEvalP_existsUnique. Its defining normalization identifies its map with the identity on the fibre-product sections. Both native continuous-module carriers have these same underlying sections; apply that normalization at H.unop and use heq_of_eq to retain the native source and target carrier presentations.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleEvalP_sections_heq {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : Modules R φ X) (n : ℕ) (H : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (x : ((eval R φ Y n).obj ((push R φ f).obj M)).val.obj H) :
    HEq (((moduleEvalP R φ f n).hom.app M).val.app H x) x
